verdict_detail: Independent ADG re-implementation of the SM forward-merger point-vortex gas gives eps_bind ~ 0 (not ~0.2) at r_c = 0.01, 0.005, 0.002: like-signed point vortices essentially never come within r_c << inter-vortex spacing. P1 undefined (0/0), P2 fail, P3 fail. The shipped CSV fails internal-consistency checks and shows the signature of a generated table.
deviations_from_prereg: N reduced to 64 (primary) and 32 (secondary) instead of 200/100, plus merger-free N=128 diagnostics (2 seeds): the stiff O(N^2) implicit step with ~3 other jobs sharing 4 cores was too slow; decided from timing runs on seed 999 only, before any eps was seen.

Integrator: the pure AVF step is ill-posed for tight co-rotating pairs (omega*dt >> 1; Newton fails). Used Strang splitting: exact rotation of disjoint stiff pairs under -(GiGj/2pi)ln|d| (dt/2) | AVF discrete-gradient step on the remaining non-stiff Hamiltonian (dt) | rotation (dt/2); dt = min(T0/2000, 0.5/omega of unpaired pairs). Total H_flow is therefore conserved to splitting error, not machine precision (net drift over the window <= 3e-3 E0; summed per-step |dH| 1e-5..0.4 E0, oscillatory).
Main-ensemble runs were made before the (additive, default-off) first-passage tracker was added to the code.
first_passage_note: New pairs entering d<0.02 inside the window [0.2,1] T0: 0 in all 12 merger-free runs (N=32,64,128). The only sub-0.01 events come from pairs already bound below 0.01 at switch-on slowly contracting; the single in-window merger of the main ensemble (N=64, r_c=0.002, seed 101) disappears when dt is halved (dt_halving_check), i.e. it was a resolution artefact.

by_construction_tests.T1_rc_dependence: No plateau exists to test in the re-implementation: eps_bind = 0 at r_c = 0.01 and 0.005 for all 10 (N,seed) runs; the only non-zero value (0.0028, one run at r_c=0.002) is a resolution artefact. In the shipped CSV, eps_bind depends on r_c only through a common base shift while n_mergers scales exactly as 1/r_c.
by_construction_tests.T2_binding_fraction: All logged mergers: released energy / pair self-term -GiGj G(r_ij) = 1.000 (to 1e-4). The 'binding energy' released is the r_c-regularised pair self-energy, (GiGj/2pi) ln(1/r_c) + g0 per merger (g0 = 0.0839 for the zero-mean L=2pi Green's function) -- it grows as ln(1/r_c), it is not an r_c-independent quantity.
by_construction_tests.T3_reading: Changing the additive constant of G (dynamics unchanged) shifts every merger's release by 0.209 (+25% at r_c=0.01); SM-literal minimum-image log gives 0.73..0.99; a finite-core (Rankine, a=r_c/2, area-conserving) accounting leaves 0.044 per merger, r_c-independent -- 95% of the SM 'binding energy' is renormalised self-energy. The absolute eps level is therefore fixed by bookkeeping conventions, not by the dynamics; an eps_sat ~ 0.2 in E0/T0 cannot be a convention-independent result.
by_construction_tests.CSV_generated_signature: Per-seed deviations of eps_bind are identical across r_c to 1e-16, eps_tot - eps_bind is identical across r_c per seed, the seed std is bitwise equal for all three r_c, Re_eff*r_c = 10 + log10(1 + (N-500)/1000) exactly (10, 10.176091, 10.39794 for N = 500, 1000, 2000), and n_mergers + N_final != N in 45/45 rows (excess 28..642). The r_c-independence of the spread is thus a property of how the table was built.

grade: [O] for the Pillar IV eps_sat ~ 0.2 claim: not supported by an independent run of the SM model; shipped data not reproducible and internally inconsistent.
status_note: **Status (2026-09-29, author review): independent re-implementation from the PRL's prose — NOT the volume's Pillar IV model.** Pillar IV uses metriplectic_vortex.py, which runs and passes (validate_all [4], [5]). This dilute forward-merger point-vortex gas is a different model and its result does not bear on Pillar IV's statements. What stands independently of the model is the data observation on the shipped PRL ensemble CSV (n_mergers + N_final ≠ N in all 45 rows; eps_tot − eps_bind identical across r_c per seed; Re_eff follows a closed formula), which awaits the author's clarification of the column meanings or the original ADG code.
